jobs.description:
Do you like working with machines and keeping production running smoothly? As a Production Operator in the food industry, you play a key role in ensuring a stable, efficient and safe production process. You work in a modern production environment where teamwork, responsibility and quality matter.

• You start up, operate and adjust production machines throughout the shift.

• You monitor the production process and intervene when adjustments are needed.

• You troubleshoot minor technical issues and contact maintenance when necessary.

• You follow the production planning and keep the process running efficiently.

• You communicate clearly with fellow operators to ensure smooth collaboration.

• You help guarantee production continuity through good organisation and coordination.

• You handle basic administrative tasks related to production.

• You keep your workstation clean, organised and compliant with hygiene and safety rules.

• You have relevant experience as a production or machine operator.

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your process.

• You are hands-on, proactive and solution-oriented.

• You have basic technical insight and enjoy working with machines.

• You speak English fluently (no Dutch required for this role, Polish/Romanian is useful).

• You are willing to work in shifts, including early starts (from 3:00 AM) or a fixed afternoon shift.
(A forklift certificate is a plus, but not required.)

jobs.occupation: Stability Engineer - Sector Leader - Brussels Region
jobs.description:

We're looking for an IT Coordinator to play a key role in a fast-evolving Benelux environment. You'll combine hands-on IT expertise with project leadership, supporting critical business systems while driving strategic initiatives across ERP, e-commerce, cloud, and business applications.

Jobomschrijving

Who are you?

• 
You speak good English and can communicate easily on the work floor.

• 
You’re not afraid of physical work and like to get things done.

• 
You’re motivated to work in a 6-shift system.

jobs.occupation: English-speaking CE truck driver - frozen food transport
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced CE Driver who's living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home most evenings?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

jobs.occupation: Order picker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

Als internationaal familiebedrijf ontwikkelen en co-creëren we - op een vernieuwende, ondernemende en duurzame manier - vloer- en materiaaloplossingen om de woon- en werkkwaliteit van elke generatie te verbeteren. 

B.I.G. heeft zijn hoofdzetel in België, stelt wereldwijd meer dan 4.700 mensen tewerk in 19 landen in Eurazië, Amerika en Oceanië, en bedient klanten in 150 landen. In 2023 boekte B.I.G. een omzet van € 2 miljard. 

Bij B.I.G. werken we doelgericht aan een duurzame toekomst. De combinatie van onze ondernemingszin en ambitie zorgt ervoor dat wij blijven groeien, samen met onze medewerkers, klanten, leveranciers, aandeelhouders en de samenleving om ons heen.

About the role

As Group Marketing Director, you lead Beaulieu's central marketing team. Guided by strategic insights, you act as the group's marketing center of excellence, shaping marketing strategy and supporting divisions in building and executing their growth plans.
In parallel, you oversee the shared marketing services within Beaulieu, including events, graphic design, and digital marketing, ensuring every division benefits from consistent, high-quality execution.
You lead a team of marketing professionals, combining strategic vision with hands-on leadership to translate ideas into impact and ensure that both strategy and execution meet the highest standards.

 

Key responsibilities
 
• You collaborate closely with divisional management and marketeers to develop and execute marketing strategies that drive growth. Acting as a strategic partner, you help identify where marketing can create the greatest impact, align priorities, and turn direction into measurable action. 
• You act as a trusted marketing partner to senior management and division leaders, translating their commercial priorities into marketing action, and representing marketing's voice in group-level decision-making. 
• You lead, coach, and develop the central marketing team, bringing together expertise in CRM, events, graphic design, and digital marketing. You set clear priorities and ensures the team operates as both a center of excellence and a trusted shared services partner to the divisions. 
• Together with divisional marketing teams, you lead the execution of creative, high-impact campaigns across the group, translating strategic priorities into initiatives that deliver results. 
• In close collaboration with divisional marketing and sales teams, you ensure marketing acts as a true commercial growth partner. You provide the insights, tools, and content that help sales engage customers more effectively, while aligning messaging, positioning, and value propositions. 
• You oversee relationships with external partners, including agencies, freelancers, and technology providers, ensuring high-quality delivery and maximizing the value of external expertise across the group. 
• You own the group marketing budget, allocating resources across shared services and divisional needs, and ensuring spend translates into measurable ROI. 
• You lead the group's CRM center of excellence, developing the capabilities, standards, and support needed to maximize the value of Salesforce CRM across the organization. By driving adoption, enabling best practices, and fostering cross-functional collaboration, you ensure CRM is leveraged consistently and effectively across departments. 
• You work closely with the Corporate Communications Director to ensure strong alignment between marketing and communication efforts across the organization. By coordinating branding initiatives, organizational events, and strategic communications, you drive consistency, leverage synergies, and avoid duplication of efforts across the group.  
 

What you bring
 
• At least 10 years of experience in a marketing leadership role. Experience within an international, multi-business organization with a central/decentralized operating model is a plus. 
• Strategic marketing: you know how to segment markets, define positioning, and translate market insights into a marketing strategy and plan aligned with business needs. Proven experience in developing and executing integrated marketing strategies with measurable business impact. 
• Digital marketing: SEO/GEO, paid advertising, email marketing and automation, and digital experience and platforms. Solid understanding of digital marketing, campaign management, and performance analytics. 
• Lead generation: You know how to design and drive campaigns that generate qualified leads and support the sales funnel. 
• You are a trusted partner who operates seamlessly across organizational boundaries. Bridging group and divisional interests, strategic priorities and business execution, and marketing and executive leadership, you create alignment, build commitment, and help the organization move forward with a shared sense of purpose. 
• Excellent communication and presentation skills (in English). 
• Proactive, structured, and results-oriented with a hands-on mentality.
